imputation: Training-sample feature medians only; all-training-missing features receive zero. Fixed missingness indicators for all features.
precipitation_target: Twelve nonnegative fractions; fit wet training hours only. Clip and normalize predicted fractions, multiply by known current hourly total.
other_targets: Twelve residuals relative to own current coarse mean; predictions projected onto known mean and applicable bounds.
settings_status: Frozen settings. Validation stations have zero hyperparameter tuning trials.
future_coarse_visibility: Same-hour and previous/next-hour coarse inputs are intentional offline conditions, not forecasts.
station_exposure: Per-variable and per-track training_wbans are the actual WBANs contributing at least one fitted row after both sampling caps; membership in the train hash group alone does not imply exposure.

evaluation_protocols.complete_hour_precipitation_2021_2025: Tier 1 events in 2021–2025 at held-out test WBANs with complete official-hourly envelopes.
